title: System Configurations
page_description: Internal company details, currency, API credentials, and admin notification settings.
form_description: Configure company details for invoices, multi-currency defaults, API keys, and the admin notification email.

company_details.title: Company Details
company_details.description: Used on invoices. Falls back to website contact settings when left blank.
company_details.sign_image_hint: Appears on invoices as the authorized signature.

currency.title: Default Currency
currency.description: System-wide base currency used for ledgers, budgets, and exchange-rate snapshots.
currency.default_hint: New transactions and budgets default to this currency. Exchange rates are fetched relative to it.

api_configs.title: Exchange Rate API
api_configs.description: Credentials used to refresh live FX rates for multi-currency accounting.
api_configs.fixer_api_key_hint: Used to fetch live exchange rates. Keep this secret — it is not shared to the public site.

admin_notifications.title: Admin Notifications
admin_notifications.description: All system notification emails are sent to this address.
admin_notifications.email_hint: Overrides ADMIN_EMAIL from .env when set. Supports comma-separated addresses.

admin_branding.title: Admin Panel Branding
admin_branding.description: Logos shown in the admin sidebar and mobile header.
admin_branding.logo_hint: Displayed in the sidebar and mobile header. Recommended size: 245 × 45 px.
admin_branding.min_logo_hint: Shown when the sidebar is collapsed. Falls back to the admin logo when not set. Recommended size: 50 × 50 px.

backup.title: Automatic Backup
backup.description: Schedule database backups. Manual backups can also be created from the Backups page.
backup.enabled_hint: Uses the interval below. Requires the server cron: php artisan schedule:run
backup.interval_days_hint: Create an automatic backup every N days (1–365).

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint Machine
fingerprint.description: Connect to a ZKTeco device over TCP/IP. Employee IDs in Symfonix are mapped to device user IDs for enrollment and attendance sync.
fingerprint.enabled_hint: When disabled, HR sync actions are blocked.
fingerprint.host_hint: LAN IP address of the ZKTeco fingerprint terminal.
fingerprint.comm_key_hint: Numeric device comm password (0 if unset on the device).
fingerprint.timeout_hint: Socket timeout for device operations (3–60 seconds).
fingerprint.name_encoding_hint: Device codepage for employee names (UTF-8, Windows-1256 for Arabic, etc.).
